card.name: Punctuation after dates and citations
card.fires_on: Punctuation or a final digit that closes a date, sentence or citation in web text, such as a dash after a dateline, a table bar, or a bracket after a sentence end.

modes.label: Dates and datelines
modes.description: The last digit of a year or a dash right after a date that opens an article.
modes.example: May 30, 2012<<–>>The Ohio legislature cleared a fracking bill May

modes.label: Separators after a sentence or entry
modes.description: A bar, bracket or parenthesis right after a sentence end or catalog entry, leading into references or metadata.

card.plain: It fires on the punctuation mark or last digit that ends a date or sentence just before a new item such as a citation or table field begins.
